description: This Dart source file defines the DocumentRepository class, which provides CRUD and query operations for managing documents in a database within a Flutter application. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, searching, and moving documents, as well as streaming change events for UI updates.

classes.name: DocumentRepository
classes.description: Provides CRUD, query, and change stream functionalities for documents in the database.

classes.name: DocumentChange
classes.description: Represents change events (create, update, delete) for documents.

classes.name: DocumentChangeType
classes.description: Enumeration of the types of document change events.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document record in the database.

methods.name: getDocumentById
methods.description: Retrieves a document by its ID.

methods.name: getAllDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves all documents ordered by last update.

methods.name: getDocumentsByFolder
methods.description: Retrieves documents belonging to a specific folder or uncategorized.

methods.name: updateDocument
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing document.

methods.name: searchDocuments
methods.description: Searches documents by name or tags.

methods.name: moveDocuments
methods.description: Reassigns documents from one folder to another.
